image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is black plastic with a white paper label on the top face featuring red handwritten text and graffiti-style markings. Two circular windows reveal the internal spools, which appear to have white hubs. A rectangular opening at the bottom exposes the dark magnetic tape and internal mechanical guides. The image has a grainy, filtered aesthetic.
